notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36391451/8cef9af16895a456d9f4e98998ad44f2732836dc.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36391451/148fb3ca692437bd0b8eb9c1c96355bc67d212b0.jpg[/img][/url]
- The camera moved higher. For a larger overview.
- Less dark night. More enjoyable to play.
- Bosses revised. They have become easier, but there are more of them!
- Revised prices and loot balance.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
- The bodies of corpses don't freeze at the start of the game
- Icon of the canister at the truck
- Client can see the flames of the Fire Boss
- Other minor bugs

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
- Gasoline icon on the truck
